Does the condition |U_i - U_{i+1}| ≤ X apply to the upper teeth after grinding, or to both upper and lower teeth?
Can we choose to grind multiple teeth in a single operation, or is each reduction of 1 on a single tooth a separate operation costing 1 yen?
